consequence.statement: Pod restart events are no longer attached to the Pod as regardingObject, so event listings using a Pod regardingObject field-selector will not find them until the selector specifies the Kafka resource.
consequence.remediation: Update field-selectors on regardingObject to specify the Kafka resource instead of the Pod.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as regardingObject; field-selectors on regardingObject must target the Kafka resource instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on external clients using regardingObject field-selectors to list events; no configuration predicate can show this.
